```{r}
library(tximport)
library(rnaseqGene)
library(DESeq2)
library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(PoiClaClu)
library(sva)
library(dplyr)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(factoextra)
```

```{r create object}
samples = data.frame(sample = c("RP-2197_DFCI-BLSKOGVH-01-AD-01_v3_RNA_OnPrem.rsem","RP-2197_DFCI-BLSKOGVH-01-AE-01_v3_RNA_OnPrem.rsem","RP-2197_DFCI-BLSKOGVH-01-UE-01_v3_RNA_OnPrem.rsem"),ID = c("AD","AE","UE"),condition = c("affected","affected","unaffected"),
                     layer = c("Dermis","Epidermis","Epidermis"))

files <- file.path('/Bulk RNA/BLSKOGVH01', "RSEM",  paste0(samples$sample, ".genes.results.gz"))
names(files) <-c("AD","AE","UE")
txi.rsem <- tximport(files, type = "rsem", txIn = FALSE, txOut = FALSE)
head(txi.rsem$counts)

```
```{r create object}
txi.rsem$length[txi.rsem$length == 0] <- 1
ensembl.genes <- rownames(txi.rsem$counts)
geneIDs1 <- ensembldb::select(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86, keys= substring(ensembl.genes,1,15), keytype = "GENEID", columns = c("SYMBOL","GENEID"))
dds.rsem<- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi.rsem,
                                   colData = samples,
                                  design = ~  condition)
```

```{r prefiltering}
#pre-filtering
nrow(dds.rsem) #60669
dds.prefiltered = dds.rsem[rowSums(counts(dds.rsem)) > 0 ,] #remove genes that are not expressed in any sample
nrow(dds.prefiltered) #26849
```


```{r DGE}
dds.prefiltered = DESeq(dds.prefiltered)
res = results(dds.prefiltered)
sum(res$padj < 0.05,na.rm = T) #103
res$symbol = mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                    keys = substring(row.names(res),1,15),
                    column = "SYMBOL",
                    keytype = "ENSEMBL",
                    multiVals = "first")

res_tb = data.frame(genes = row.names(res),log2fc = res$log2FoldChange,padj = res$padj,symbol = res$symbol)

resLFC1 = results(dds.prefiltered,lfcThreshold = 1)
table(resLFC1$padj < 0.05)

DEGs = na.omit(unique(rownames(res)[res$padj < 0.05]))
DEGs_symbol = geneIDs1 %>% dplyr::filter(GENEID %in% substring(DEGs,1,15)) %>% dplyr::select(SYMBOL) %>% as.vector() %>% unlist()
DEGsLFC1 = na.omit(unique(rownames(resLFC1)[resLFC1$padj < 0.05]))
DEGsLFC1_symbol = geneIDs1 %>% dplyr::filter(GENEID %in% substring(DEGsLFC1,1,15)) %>% dplyr::select(SYMBOL) %>% as.vector() %>% unlist()
resLFC1$symbol = mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                    keys = substring(row.names(resLFC1),1,15),
                    column = "SYMBOL",
                    keytype = "ENSEMBL",
                    multiVals = "first")
resLFC1$entrez = mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                    keys = substring(row.names(resLFC1),1,15),
                    column = "ENTREZID",
                    keytype = "ENSEMBL",
                    multiVals = "first")
resLFC1Ordered = resLFC1[order(resLFC1$padj),]
topGene = rownames(resLFC1)[which.min(resLFC1$padj)]
plotCounts(dds.prefiltered,gene = 'ENSG00000170454.6',intgroup = c("ID"),returnData = T)
plotCounts(dds.prefiltered,gene = DEGsLFC1[30],intgroup = c("ID"),returnData = T)
plotCounts(dds.prefiltered,gene = DEGsLFC1[23],intgroup = c("ID"),returnData = T)
plotCounts(dds.prefiltered,gene = DEGsLFC1[26],intgroup = c("ID"),returnData = T)
plotCounts(dds.prefiltered,gene = DEGsLFC1[38],intgroup = c("ID"),returnData = T)

```
```{r}

pc = prcomp(t(assay(rld)[DEGs,]),rank. = 2)
fviz_eig(pc)
fviz_pca_ind(pc,
             repel = TRUE     # Avoid text overlapping
             )
fviz_pca_var(pc,
             col.var = "contrib", # Color by contributions to the PC
             gradient.cols = c("#00AFBB", "#E7B800", "#FC4E07"),
             repel = TRUE     # Avoid text overlapping
             )
loadings = as.data.frame(pc$rotation)
aload = abs(loadings)
sweep(aload, 2, colSums(aload), "/")
aload$symbol = DEGs_symbol
rownames(res_tb) = res_tb$genes
aload$log2fc = res_tb[rownames(aload),'log2fc']
aload$padj = res_tb[rownames(aload),'padj']
xlsx::write.xlsx(aload,"~/Downloads/aload1.xlsx")
```

```{r}
AD.tpm <- read.delim(file="Bulk RNA/BLSKOGVH01/RNA-seQC/RP-2197_DFCI-BLSKOGVH-01-AD-01_v3_RNA_OnPrem.gene_tpm.gct.gz", skip=2)
AE.tpm <- read.delim(file="/Bulk RNA/BLSKOGVH01/RNA-seQC/RP-2197_DFCI-BLSKOGVH-01-AE-01_v3_RNA_OnPrem.gene_tpm.gct.gz", skip=2)
UE.tpm <- read.delim(file="Bulk RNA/BLSKOGVH01/RNA-seQC/RP-2197_DFCI-BLSKOGVH-01-UE-01_v3_RNA_OnPrem.gene_tpm.gct.gz", skip=2)

rownames(UE.tpm)  = UE.tpm$Name

rownames(AD.tpm)  = AD.tpm$Name

xlsx::write.xlsx(aload1,"Bulk RNA/BLSKOGVH01/aload1.xlsx")
```

```{r}
AD.tpm <- read.delim(file="Bulk RNA/blaschko01/RNA-seQC/RP-2197_DFCI-BLSKOGVH-01-AD-01_v3_RNA_OnPrem.gene_tpm.gct.gz", skip=2)

AE.tpm <- read.delim(file="Bulk RNA/blaschko01/RNA-seQC/RP-2197_DFCI-BLSKOGVH-01-AE-01_v3_RNA_OnPrem.gene_tpm.gct.gz", skip=2)

UE.tpm <- read.delim(file="Bulk RNA/blaschko01/RNA-seQC/RP-2197_DFCI-BLSKOGVH-01-UE-01_v3_RNA_OnPrem.gene_tpm.gct.gz", skip=2)

rownames(UE.tpm)  = UE.tpm$Name
TPM = merge(AD.tpm,AE.tpm)
TPM = merge(TPM,UE.tpm)
colnames(TPM) = c("GeneID","GeneSymbol","AD","AE","UE")
openxlsx::write.xlsx(TPM,'Bulk RNA/blaschko01/TPM_0_AD_AE_UE.xlsx')
```
